evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen to 13.1 ppm from 28764.1 ppm at 120 s.
Growth temperature has settled to 750.3 °C against a 750 °C setpoint, with heater power 43.4%; the initial growth overshoot resolved.
Pressure remains stable at 2.906 Torr, oxygen is low at 3.7 ppm, and controller reports running.
Argon flow sensor is not installed; null Ar telemetry is expected rather than evidence of a fault.
Growth stage is verifiable with no required sensors missing.

args.missing_evidence: Post-run sample characterization is needed to determine whether the target material grew; actual argon flow is not directly measured by the installed sensors.
